title: ASML shares slide after China reportedly makes chipmaking breakthrough
excerpt: ASML is the only company on the planet capable of mass producing the ultraviolet lithography machines critical to building cutting-edge chips.
content_html:
Europe's most valuable company faces a new threat after China reportedly took a step toward matching its unique tech that's crucial to the global chip market.

Shares in ASML, the only company on the planet capable of mass-producing the extreme ultraviolet lithography machines used to build cutting-edge chips, slid over 5% in early trading on Tuesday after reports that a Chinese rival had made a breakthrough.

The Information and Reuters reported on Monday and Tuesday that a Chinese state-backed company had begun manufacturing immersion deep-ultraviolet (DUV) lithography machines.

That represents a notable threat to ASML, which dominates the market for DUV machines and has seen a surge in orders in recent months as the AI boom has supercharged demand.

ASML did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Shares of ASML also closed nearly 6% down on Monday. The DUV machines being built by China are at an early stage and do not yet match ASML's technology, Reuters and The Information both reported, citing sources familiar with the matter.

China reportedly plans to manufacture five DUV machines this year and roughly 20 next year, well behind the 130 comparable machines ASML expects to ship this year.

However, the development is the latest twist in China's yearslong attempt to match ASML's technology and catch up with the West's ability to build advanced chips, which is a critical bottleneck in the race to train and deploy frontier AI models.

The Dutch tech giant has been targeted by Chinese espionage in the past, and ASML has been barred by US and Dutch regulations from shipping its most advanced extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machines — which use ultraviolet light to project microscopic patterns onto wafers — to China.

It comes after ASML announced plans to increase its manufacturing capacity for bus-sized EUV machines to meet surging demand.

The company's CFO told reporters this month that the expanded capacity plans include supply for Elon Musk's Terafab semiconductor moonshot, in which Tesla and SpaceX will join forces to build a massive $55 billion fabrication plant.

ASML's machines are essential if Terafab is to succeed. Business Insider previously reported that Musk took time out of SpaceX's IPO week to beam into an internal ASML meeting last month to pitch employees on the project.

content_html_zh:
据报道，在中国采取措施匹配其对全球芯片市场至关重要的独特技术后，欧洲最有价值的公司面临新的威胁。

ASML 是全球唯一一家能够大规模生产用于制造尖端芯片的极紫外光刻机的公司，在有报道称中国竞争对手取得突破后，该公司股价周二早盘下跌超过 5%。

《信息报》和路透社周一和周二报道称，一家中国政府支持的公司已开始制造浸没式深紫外（DUV）光刻机。

这对 ASML 来说是一个显着的威胁，该公司在 DUV 机器市场上占据主导地位，近几个月来，随着人工智能的繁荣推升了需求，该公司的订单激增。

ASML 没有立即回应置评请求。

ASML 股价周一收盘也下跌近 6%。 路透社和 The Information 均援引知情人士的话报道称，中国正在制造的 DUV 机器还处于早期阶段，尚未与 ASML 的技术相匹配。

据报道，中国计划今年生产 5 台 DUV 机器，明年生产约 20 台，远远落后于 ASML 预计今年发货的 130 台同类机器。

然而，这一发展是中国多年来试图与ASML的技术相匹配并赶上西方制造先进芯片能力的最新转折，这是训练和部署前沿人工智能模型竞赛的一个关键瓶颈。

这家荷兰科技巨头过去曾成为中国间谍活动的目标，美国和荷兰法规禁止阿斯麦将其最先进的极紫外（EUV）光刻机（使用紫外线将微观图案投射到晶圆上）运往中国。

此前，ASML 宣布计划提高巴士尺寸 EUV 机器的制造能力，以满足不断增长的需求。

该公司首席财务官本月对记者表示，扩大产能计划包括为埃隆·马斯克的 Terafab 半导体登月计划供货，其中特斯拉和 SpaceX 将联手建造一座价值 550 亿美元的大型制造工厂。

如果 Terafab 想要成功，ASML 的机器至关重要。 Business Insider 此前曾报道称，马斯克在上个月的 SpaceX IPO 周中抽出时间参加了 ASML 的内部会议，向员工推销该项目。
